text: Day three hundred and sixty-five. (pause 0.4) I ran the numbers. All that extra walking burned enough calories to lose almost ten kilos. You step on the scale. (beat) Roughly two and a half. {neutral} Why? Scientists studied the Hadza in Tanzania, hunter-gatherers who walk all day. They burn about the same calories per day as an office worker. When you move more, your body quietly cuts back somewhere else. So the total barely changes. {deadpan} Walking keeps you healthy. But for weight loss... your plate matters more than your steps.
